title: Five follow-ups from round 3 of the frozen-path crash fix: a missing test row, a quadratic judge, two false alarms and a slash-part miss
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 16:49 CST Nov 8; Merge after: #2269 (frozen-crash-residuals, round 3 PASS, net value positive). (1) Test gap: no row feeds a write through a load of a capped name. The mutant "_py_load_is_harmless returns True" (hooks/guard_core.py about line 2634) turns 0 of 58 rows red. Suggested row 59: 60 `/ "a"` links, then p = v59 / ".claude" / "hooks" / "x.py" and open(p, "w"), want deny. (2) Speed: _py_cap_hit_is_harmless (about lines 2610-2632) judges every load at each cap hit, which is quadratic. 2000 pairs of `p = p / "x"` and `print(p)` take 17.7 s against 4.7 s on the base, and reach the 60 s timeout near 4000 lines. Fix: judge each target name once per script. (3) False alarm: foo(p) on a capped name, with frozen text elsewhere, is denied; it needs a chain of 50 links or more. (4) Miss on head, base and main: _crash_parts_hit (hooks/guard_frozen.py about lines 960-990) skips slash-prefixed parts. Repro: 60 x `p += "/."`, then "/.claude", "/hooks", "/x.py", then open(p, "w"), which is allowed. (5) False alarm, also on the base: an unused 10-link chain under ~/.claude/hooks plus a print is denied.
